summary.en: The Rapid Support Forces launched a drone strike on Nyala, killing at least 21 people, injuring 40 and cutting power in southeast Sudan. In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese Armed Forces repelled a fresh RSF and SPLM-N assault, seizing 15 combat vehicles. Women under siege are increasingly acting as frontline responders to meet basic needs as the war continues. World leaders are urging urgent aid access as the United Nations warns of a looming famine risk. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen gjennomførte et droneangrep på Nyala, der minst 21 personer ble drept, 40 ble såret og strømmen ble kuttet i sør-øst Sudan. I Blå Nil avverget den sudanske hæren (SAF) et nytt angrep fra RSF og SPLM-N, og tok kontroll over 15 kampkjøretøy. Kvinner under beleiring handler i økende grad som frontlinje-respondenter for å dekke grunnleggende behov mens krigen pågår. Verdensledere oppfordrer til umiddelbar humanitær tilgang mens FN advarer om en truende hungersnødsrisiko. Konflikten forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
